description: This file contains implementation of Unicode string conversion utilities, including offset adjustments for UTF-8 and UTF-16 conversions, within the 'base' namespace. It defines the OffsetAdjuster class methods and template functions for converting Unicode characters between different encodings, with support for offset adjustments.

classes.name: OffsetAdjuster::Adjustment
classes.description: Represents an adjustment to string offsets, storing original offset, original length, and output length.

methods.name: OffsetAdjuster::AdjustOffsets
methods.description: Adjusts a list of offsets based on a set of string adjustments, up to a limit.

methods.name: OffsetAdjuster::AdjustOffset
methods.description: Adjusts a single offset based on string adjustments and a limit.

methods.name: OffsetAdjuster::UnadjustOffsets
methods.description: Reverts offset adjustments for a list of offsets.

methods.name: OffsetAdjuster::MergeSequentialAdjustments
methods.description: Merges two sets of string adjustments into one, maintaining correct offsets.

methods.name: ConvertUnicode
methods.description: Template function converting Unicode characters between source and destination string types, recording adjustments if requested.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16WithAdjustments
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 to UTF-16 with offset adjustments.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16WithAdjustments (overload)
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 to UTF-16 and returns the result, recording adjustments.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16AndAdjustOffsets
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 to UTF-16, adjusting provided offsets accordingly.

methods.name: UTF16ToUTF8AndAdjustOffsets
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 to UTF-8, adjusting provided offsets accordingly.
